claims.name: AuthenticationController
responsibilities: exposes POST /api/auth/register and forwards the request to the facade

claims.name: LibraryFacade
responsibilities: facade that delegates registration to UserManager

claims.name: UserManager
responsibilities: validates role is Student or Librarian and password length

claims.name: UserManager
responsibilities: validates student number format and librarian code

claims.name: UserRegistry
responsibilities: looks up users by email, student number, librarian code

claims.name: PersistenceManager
responsibilities: persists entities in a JPA transaction and runs field queries

claims.name: LibrarianFactory
responsibilities: creates Librarian with internal identifier code

claims.name: RestExceptionHandler
responsibilities: maps validation failures to HTTP 400 responses
